How to use CMVC handling defects

Posted on 2020-10-21 | In Tools

CMVC, stands for Configuration Management Version Control, it is an IBM internal product. GPFS uses CMVC to track defects, this article is to provide steps how to setup and use it.

Request a new CMVC ID

There are many CMVC families, as a FVT/PTF member, we only need to access two families, hpssl and aix.

Firstly, go to Reqauth4Me tool to request a new CMVC ID. You will be asked to input information before clicking the Submit button.

Login: (Login limited to 15 alphanumeric characters)
Family: (hpssl or aix)
Justification: (Justification limited to 130 characters)

Have better to choose a US approver to approve your request, some approver have no idea about your request. Each request only can choose one family, so you need to submit two times due to two families here.

Set password for the new CMVC ID

After the requests are approved by an approver, you will receive a system email, then you should set password on it before using it.

Go to Reqauth4Me tool again, click “Query Logins” in the left menu panel, provide below information then click Submit button.

Serial: (Your serial number) CMVC Login ID: (The login name you defined) Family: (hpssl or aix)

A matched login will be returned in the query results, select it then click “Set Password” button to apply a password for your login ID.

Obtain a CMVC Client

You can download a CMVC client by platform from CMVC support, then install it by following up the Installation Instructions.

Configuration for handling GPFS defects

When open a defect for GPFS, choose aix family. When open a defect for fixing hardware/software issue of the testing environment, choose hpssl family.

  • Launch CMVC client on MacOS

    # java -jar CMVC.jar

  • Click the menu File -> Startup Wizard -> Next -> Enter your CMVC login ID, then Next -> Enter the family you want to access, then Next -> Next -> Enter the component name you want to access, then Next -> Type “na” for Release -> Finish

    hpssl@bldcmvc01.pok.ibm.com@9999   component: gpfs.hw         (for FVT)
                                              PPSLAB_software (for PTF)
aix@auscmvc1.austin.ibm.com@2035   component: mmfs

The process to handle defects by CMVC client

Open a defect

  1. For GPFS defect, ensure aix family and component mmfs on CMVC client.

    Actions -> Defects -> Open… -> Fill below mandatory fields at least -> OK

    Remarks:
    Severity:
    Phase found: // post_ga for PTF
    custProbabilty:

  2. For testing environment defect, ensure hpssl family and component gpfs.hw or PPSLAB_software on CMVC client.

    Actions -> Defects -> Open… -> Fill below mandatory fields at least -> OK

    Example:

    Remarks: Failed to upgrade the node to RHEL 8.x
    Abstract: c550f5u01 - Reimage RHEL 8.3
    Prefix: sr
    Severity: 2
    Symptom: support_request
    Phase found: n/a

Update a defect

  • For GPFS defect, can update it on RTC.

  • For testing environment defect, follow below actions to add a comment without changing other fields:

    Actions -> Defects -> Remarks -> Add…

Re-open a defect

  • For testing environment defect, can re-open it if its state was returned but need further assist.

    Actions -> Defects -> Reopen…

Close a defect

  1. For GPFS defect, we can update and close it on RTC.

  2. For testing environment defect, when its state is “verify”, follow below actions to close it on CMVC client.

    Objects -> Defects -> Verification Records… -> Enter your CMVC login ID in the field “Owner ID”, and select “ready” in the field “State” -> OK

    It will show the matched defect in a new window, then right click the defect and choose “Accept…”, later the defect’s state will turn to “closed” automatically.
